## Themes

- Choose separate themes for light and dark mode, from the built-in themes or the hundreds in the iTerm2-Color-Schemes collection, through a searchable gallery in Settings.
- Theme colors can now color just the accent or every control in the app.
- Switching between a light and a dark theme no longer leaves control text or scroll bars in the previous theme's colors.
- Settings, Welcome and Import now blend into their tabs instead of sitting on a different color.
- The rail's top icons follow the theme like the workspace icons below them.
- The Settings page scrolls normally over theme rows, and each row has buttons to page through its themes.
- The old single theme setting is no longer read. Settings from earlier versions open with the default appearance.

## Tabs and agents

- Colour tags show as a line along the top of every tagged tab, not a bar at its side. The status dot and agent icon are centred again.
- A finished agent no longer shows as working forever. Selecting its tab or moving the mouse over it doesn't restart the working dot. The agent badges are redrawn more sharply.

## Terminal

- The terminal engine is updated to libghostty-vt 1.0, its first release with a stable interface. It includes faster plain-text output, several new escape sequences and fixes for selection and resizing.

## Reliability

- Crashes in background UI callbacks are now written to crash.log instead of closing the app with no record.

Choose the x64 download for Intel or AMD PCs. Choose ARM64 only for Windows on ARM devices.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/bpbp-boop/resesh/compare/v0.29.0...v0.30.0)
